units.source_text: 你真傻，要知道这个玩意儿是不能带来带去的呀。

en.t: You are so foolish; you know, this is not the sort of thing you can carry around with you.

units.source_text: 有时一放就是好几天哩。”

en.t: Sometimes I leave it there for days at a time.

units.source_text: 她刚一笑，又长吁短叹了几声，然后闭上眼睛，松开衣襟，摇摇晃晃地倒在岛村身上了。

en.t: No sooner had she laughed than she let out several weary sighs, then closed her eyes, loosened the front of her kimono, and swayed as she fell against Shimamura.
